title: A Behavior-Guided Online Probabilistic Forecasting Method for Electric Vehicle Charging Loads
key_value: Very recent direct competitor for behavior drift and online probabilistic EV load forecasting.
known_limitation: Not peer-reviewed as of verification date.

title: DiffPLF: A Conditional Diffusion Model for Probabilistic Electric Vehicle Charging Load Forecasting
key_value: Shows that conditional diffusion has already entered probabilistic charging-load forecasting.
known_limitation: Preprint status and calibration/decision-value evidence require scrutiny.

title: Federated Graph Learning for EV Charging Demand Forecasting with Personalization Against Cyberattacks
key_value: Closest frontier reference for personalized federated graph forecasting and adversarial trust.
known_limitation: Preprint; threat model and reproducibility need verification.

title: Federated Learning for Early Prediction of EV Charging Demand
prediction_target: total session energy from plug-in and first-minute observations
dataset_or_context: ACN Caltech session metadata and early-window charging measurements
key_value: Establishes early-session total-energy prediction and station-partitioned FL on ACN as an emerging operational task.
known_limitation: Preprint; one depot, no cross-operator federation, probability calibration, cyber threat model or downstream control experiment.

title: Measuring Flexibility through Reduction Potential
key_value: Potentially useful formalization for comparing flexibility metrics rather than only load errors.
known_limitation: Preprint and not necessarily a forecasting method.

title: Quantifying Realizable Flexibility Limits in Fast and Ultra-Fast EV Charging
key_value: Critical for deciding whether fast-charging stations have enough realizable flexibility to justify prediction.
known_limitation: Preprint and may focus on physical limits rather than forecasting.

title: Predictive Control of EV Overnight Charging with Multi-Session Flexibility
key_value: Relevant for translating session forecasts into rolling multi-session control.
known_limitation: Preprint; application setting is narrower than general public charging.

title: EV-STLLM: Parameter-Efficient Large Language Model Adaptation for Electric Vehicle Charging Forecasting
key_value: Useful for monitoring foundation-model adaptation without prematurely selecting it as the main method.
known_limitation: Preprint and likely compute-intensive; operational advantage must be demonstrated.

title: PiXTime: A Model for Federated Time Series Forecasting with Heterogeneous Data Structures Across Nodes
prediction_target: time series with different granularities and variable sets
key_value: Shows that heterogeneous granularity and variable-set alignment in federated TSF is already an active frontier.

title: Fed-GAME: Federated Graph-Aware Meta-Learning for Electric Vehicle Charging Demand Forecasting
key_value: Directly competes with federated/meta-learning EV demand forecasting.
known_limitation: Preprint; exact threat model and strict OOD protocol require full review.

title: PiXTime and Other Cross-Node Structural-Heterogeneity Methods — Evidence Watch
theme: heterogeneous model/data structures in federated TSF
key_value: Prevents treating heterogeneous local models or variable schemas as an unoccupied idea.
known_limitation: Not a single citable paper; use constituent records for claims.

title: TS-Inverse: A Gradient Inversion Attack Tailored for Federated Time Series Forecasting Models
prediction_target: reconstruction of observations and targets from gradients
dataset_or_context: four TSF models and four datasets
key_value: Shows that claiming privacy solely because of federated training is unsafe for time-series forecasting.
known_limitation: Preprint; attack assumptions and EV applicability require validation.

title: Spatio-temporal modelling of electric vehicle charging demand
scale: Scotland network with Glasgow modeling case study
session_level: raw sessions; model aggregated daily counts
distribution_shift: temporal, regional, tariff and infrastructure evolution
dataset_or_context: ChargePlace Scotland, October 2022–April 2025, station metadata, weather and spatial boundaries
key_value: Adds a recent multi-year national-network benchmark and an interpretable INLA uncertainty baseline suitable for temporal drift and regional holdouts.
known_limitation: Preprint; full-network prediction protocol and raw energy/power field semantics still require file-level audit.

title: A Nationwide Randomized Natural Field Experiment on Dynamic EV Charging Prices
key_value: Large causal evidence may support policy-conditioned forecasting, but data access is uncertain.
known_limitation: Working paper and likely non-public microdata.

title: Federated Anomaly Detection and Mitigation for EV Charging Forecasting Under Cyberattacks
theme: trustworthy federated forecasting/cyberattack detection and mitigation
prediction_target: EV charging demand under adversarial data corruption
dataset_or_context: real EV charging data combined with DDoS attack data
key_value: Shows that anomaly detection, mitigation and federated EV-load forecasting have already been combined under an explicit cyberattack setting.
known_limitation: Preprint; attack realism, privacy guarantees and comparison with robust aggregation require full-text and code-level audit.

title: IDEAS: Information-Driven EV Admission in Charging Station Considering User Impatience to Improve QoS and Station Utilization
prediction_target: queue joining, abandonment and station utilization under peak demand
session_level: yes; simulated arrivals and queue states
key_value: Explicitly models balking and reneging, showing why served charging records omit part of latent demand and why queue information changes behavior.
known_limitation: Preprint and simulation-based; behavioral probabilities are assumed rather than identified from public station data.

title: AI in Charge: Large-Scale Experimental Evidence on Electric Vehicle Charging Demand
prediction_target: behavioral response to AI-managed charging tariff
key_value: Large-scale evidence that algorithmic control reshapes peak-hour demand and therefore changes future training distributions.
known_limitation: Working paper; microdata and deployed controller details may not be accessible.

title: Electric Vehicles and the Energy Transition: Unintended Consequences of a Common Retail Rate Design
prediction_target: charging behavior and local capacity consequences
key_value: TOU pricing shifts demand but can create larger synchronized shadow peaks; closed-loop coordination matters.
known_limitation: Working paper and household context; exact microdata access must be checked.

title: PeakFocus: Bridging Peak Localization and Intensity Regression via a Unified Multi-Scale Framework for Electricity Load Forecasting
theme: joint peak localization and intensity regression
prediction_target: peak timing, peak magnitude and peak shape
key_value: Shows that joint peak localization and intensity regression is becoming an explicit forecasting task outside EV charging, so an EV-specific peak paper needs more than a weighted loss.
known_limitation: Not peer-reviewed and not evaluated on EV charging stations.
